title: Usage of Ethical / Deprecated Boston Housing Dataset
core_problem: The Boston Housing dataset was officially deprecated and removed from Scikit-Learn 1.2 due to ethical issues and racial bias in its B attribute.
pedagogical_impact: Students learn on deprecated datasets that fail modern ethical compliance and industry standards.
architectural_solution: Replace all occurrences with the California Housing dataset (`fetch_california_housing()`) or synthetic multi-variate housing data.

title: Absence of PyTorch 2.0+ Compiler Stack (torch.compile, TorchDynamo & Inductor)
core_problem: PyTorch 2.x fundamentally changed deep learning performance from eager python dispatch to graph capture via TorchDynamo and OpenAI Triton kernel code generation via TorchInductor.
pedagogical_impact: Students are taught purely legacy PyTorch 1.x eager execution, leaving them unaware of 2x-3x speedups, memory fusion, and CUDA graph capture standard in 2024-2026 production.
architectural_solution: Add a dedicated module in Week 8/19: 'PyTorch 2.x Compiler Internals — TorchDynamo, AOTAutograd, Inductor & Triton Kernel Fusion'.

title: Missing Production KV Cache Capacity Planning & VRAM Equation
core_problem: MLOps and LLM serving engineers must calculate exact GPU VRAM budgets for KV Cache: `Bytes = 2 × n_layers × n_kv_heads × d_head × precision_bytes × sequence_length × batch_size`.
pedagogical_impact: Students cannot perform capacity planning for vLLM / TensorRT-LLM clusters or determine maximum concurrent batch sizes before encountering OOMs.
architectural_solution: Add the formal KV cache VRAM sizing formula, GQA reduction derivation (8x memory savings vs MHA), and FP8 KV cache quantization in Week 19.

title: Absence of Subword Tokenizer Production Traps (Token-Healing & Glitch Tokens)
core_problem: Standard BPE tokenizers produce severe generation artifacts when prompts end in whitespace (token boundary mismatch), and contain 'glitch tokens' (unseen embeddings causing prompt injection or model degeneration).
pedagogical_impact: Students build LLM prompts without understanding token boundary alignment, leading to degraded prompt-following and token-healing bugs in production APIs.
architectural_solution: Add a deep dive in Week 13 on Token-Healing algorithms, Byte-level BPE fallback, and Tokenizer vocab alignment.

title: Absence of Modern Out-of-Core Tabular Engines (Polars / DuckDB / Arrow)
core_problem: Pandas loads entire datasets into uncompressed in-memory RAM with high object-pointer overhead. Production ML pipelines process 50GB-1TB tabular features using Apache Arrow columnar formats, Polars lazy execution graphs, and DuckDB out-of-core SQL.
pedagogical_impact: Students are unprepared for real-world datasets exceeding laptop RAM (50GB+), assuming Pandas is the only tabular tool.
architectural_solution: Add a modern data engineering section in Week 2/3 comparing Pandas eager execution with Polars lazy query optimization and DuckDB parquet streaming.
